headlines.text: Dow and S&P 500 futures are mixed as Trump touts hopes for an Iran settlement while Wall Street awaits midterm election results
Prediction market traders now put Democrats' odds of winning the Senate near 75%, with a sweep seen by JPMorgan as a risk for AI stocks
Treasury yields climb, with the 10-year near 4.92%, as investors weigh the midterm vote, delayed jobs data and renewed Iran tensions
Apple shares extend their slide on a weak margin outlook while Palantir tumbles further in premarket trading as post-earnings selling deepens
Marvell shares stay under pressure from its $115 billion all-stock bid for Lumentum as investors question the AI optical networking push
AMD reports Q3 earnings after today's close, with Wall Street looking for EPS near $1.95 on revenue up about 42% to $13.1 billion as data-center AI demand is tested
